setup.en: The page must be on https or localhost and start the microphone from a click; on macOS the browser needs microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
setup.zh: 網頁要在 https 或 localhost 上，並且由一次點擊啟動麥克風。在 macOS 上，瀏覽器要在「系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性」裡有麥克風權限。

use.en: Finds the Dante Virtual Soundcard among the audio inputs by its label and opens it with the browser's voice processing off, only when called.
use.zh: 依名稱在音訊輸入裡找到 Dante Virtual Soundcard，關掉瀏覽器的語音處理後打開它，呼叫了才會做。

use.en: The opened stream feeds the analyzer through input(), so a room's Dante network can drive audio/rms, the bands and the drum hits.
use.zh: 打開的串流經 input() 接進分析器，現場的 Dante 網路就能推動 audio/rms、三個頻段和鼓的偵測。

tbd.en: Whether Chrome lists the Dante Virtual Soundcard as an audio input, under which label, and how many of its channels a page receives, is not checked.
tbd.zh: Chrome 會不會把 Dante Virtual Soundcard 列成音訊輸入、名稱是什麼、網頁能拿到它的幾個聲道，都還沒有確認。

tbd.en: Latency settings, sample-rate and network requirements beyond what the product page says are not read: see Audinate's user guide.
